svg.title: Toolkit, server
svg.desc: Isometric keyboard where each tool is a keycap carrying its logo. The keys strike one after another and flash their brand colour, packets run along the floor grid, and tools in production project a turning hologram of their logo. A name panel sits beside it. backend: node.js, nestjs, graphql; data: postgresql, mongodb, redis; devops: docker, kubernetes, aws, github actions. In production now: node.js, postgresql, aws.
